Name: ZG's Sandy Portrait
Author: ZZingaeS2
Description:
This portrait is Sandy.
Please note that I primarily play with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15100?tab=files]Seven Deadly Sins[/url], so I incorporated some elements from its lore into the coloring!
(In this mod, Sandy is established as Arvey’s older sister, so I only made her hair and eye colors somewhat similar to his.)

How to install

[list]
[*]If you don't already have them, download the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url]﻿ mod [/*]
[*]Download this mod.[/*]
[*]Mods/Portraiture/Portraits and create a new folder.[/*]
[*]Put the portraits from this mod into the new folder.[/*]
[/list](If you already have a folder for it, feel free to put it in the existing folder.)

You don't need to rename this file. Just put it in the name I made and it works.
[b]Please choose and install only one version: Sandy tan or Sandy light. [/b]
